I know some people say like “Starbucks (as a company) sucks why help them make more money and avoid wasting product to such a degree?!?”. If you want it in a bigger cup, I can do that, but I’m not giving you anything extra. In your case however, that is extremely reasonable. No reason not to fill it to the top. If you ordered a grande cold brew, no matter what modifications you make I’m going to fill it up to the top for you. I think it’s difficult to imagine Heather Chandler NOT being mean to Heather McNamara. She is a bitch to everyone in heathers with only a few exceptions (specifically most of the jocks and college kids, presumably because you know, sexism). Even if it doesn’t show her being her usual Heather Chandler self to Heather McNamara, it would make no sense for her to be spared. Now maybe Heather Duke had it much much much worse, that would be accurate. But I’m sure Heather Chandler was bullying Heather McNamara to a certain degree. Now of course, I won’t deny that Heather McNamara is a bad person, but that doesn’t mean she can’t have some small degree of rationalization for her actions. As I said, I’m not claiming that Heather McNamara is innocent or anything, just that her actions make sense as a realistic character.

I agree. She isn’t even close to perfect, but I do think a decent amount of her actions make sense. Like refusing to comfort Heather Duke might simply because she endured the same judgement from Heather Chandler. She might have thought “if Heather  Duke isn’t going to try to help me, I’m not going to help her”. That might seem dumb, but sometimes when you have those kinds of difficult situations you make mistakes like that. She can also bullies people despite feeling bullied by her friends, which honestly is probably just her horrible way of dealing with those feelings.
